changelog:
Mimir persistent agent memory skill, initial public release:

- Adds integration with self-hosted Mimir MCP for OpenClaw agents, enabling durable, encrypted memory storage with 23 available tools.
- Features hybrid keyword and semantic search, knowledge graph relationships, Ebbinghaus decay lifecycle management, and encrypted storage (AES-256-GCM, key optional).
- No external dependencies; runs as a standalone Rust binary on major OSes.
- Includes import/export, journal/timeline, state, conflict detection, workspace/domain management, and web dashboard support.
- Comprehensive setup and privacy documentation included.
summary: Self-hosted persistent memory for OpenClaw agents via Mimir MCP — 23 tools, hybrid search, AES-256 encryption, zero external dependencies
